messages:
leo: Heads-up — I ran an nsys timeline for the recent regressed 8k batch run. Seeing repeated gaps where kernels are ready but nothing executes for ~6-12ms, then a burst of tiny kernels.
tara: can you paste the snippet from the timeline? quick screenshot or timeline text is fine.
leo: paste from nsys summary: 
```
CUDA memcpy async: bursts on copy engine (queue 1) start aligned with CPU wakeups; avg idle window 8.7ms between memcpy and next kernel launch; kernels then serialize on stream 0
```
mike: hmm looks like default-stream synchronization or an implicit event between host thread and GPU. we've seen this when host-side batching waits for a lock+flush.
leo: exactly — the tracing shows our batching task does a small prefix-prefetch then does an explicit cudaEventRecord + cudaEventSynchronize-ish path in our runtime to avoid OOM during prefetch. That sync path forces the CPU thread to spin and the driver schedules copy then a bunch of tiny kernels after.
jana: could this be the batching heuristic shrinking seqs into many batches? if batch size drops to <4 tokens we get lots of kernel launches.
tara: yes. also I noticed the prefetch path uses host-side staging buffer fallback on a miss. If copy streams get throttled because the host thread gets preempted, we see the gap.
leo: repro steps I used: run: `python tools/bench.py --model gptx-4b --seq 8192 --batch 12 --prefetch=background` on ci-gpu-3; collect `nsys profile --trace=cuda,cudnn --output=tmp` for 60s.
perf-bot: regression-tracker: note created -> perf/regressions/1767554321
mike: short-term mitigation: avoid explicit sync in prefetch path — switch to event-query + backoff and let copy engine overlap with compute. Also try moving prefetch to a dedicated non-default stream to avoid implicit sync with stream 0.
leo: I instrumented a patch locally: changed cudaEventSynchronize -> cudaEventQuery loop with small usleep(50) and pinned prefetch to stream 3. Kernel serialization reduced, tail latency improved ~22% on the run.
jana: nice. can you post the before/after timeline image to the PR? add a small benchmark script and flag so CI can run it on nightly.
tara: long-term we should update batching heuristic: prefer slightly larger minibatches when prefetch+staging is enabled, and add a 'stall detector' that triggers coarser batching if we detect repeated <10ms idle windows between GPU ops.
mike: agree. also add telemetry counters: host-preempt-wait-count, avg-idle-ms and prefetch-stream-contention so we can alert before regression.
leo: filing a small RFC/PR for the sync-change + telemetry. I'll canary-roll to dev cluster after code review. pinging @eng-sre for canary infra.
jana: thanks — ping me once canary is up, I'll run a CV regression on outputs.
mike: small note — check multi-GPU NVLINK behaviour: on some nodes the copy engine scheduling differs and our event-query backoff may behave differently. add per-node config for backoff thresholds.
leo: copied into PR description. will upload timeline screenshots and the exact nsys command.
